race.description: Hard Fizz We Ride At Night Hcp
race.comment: TRUE AMOR (8) is a model of consistency for the Munce team and goes on top after a strong CL4 win here two back then a close third at Doomben. Gets in light with the 3kg claimer engaged and has enough early muster to offset the wide draw. Expecting him to prove hard to run down. SHIRVINGTON (5) came from a mile back to arrive just in time here last time. Winning hoop sticks and if he can settle a touch closer this time he's right in the mix again. ALPHA BRAVO (10) lacked a fitness edge late when resuming at Ipswich but will be better second-up and could run away with it if left alone in front. MONEY TEAM (9) could add some juice into the exotics if he can reproduce an effort similar to his narrow defeat on the Kenso two back.
